name: Grainturk Holding A.S.
summary: GRAINTURK Holding A.S. operates in the field of agricultural commodity trade on national and international platforms. It is involved in the trading of wheat, corn, cotton, barely, sunflower seeds, soybeans, wheat bran, sunflower meals, soybean meals, cotton meals, sunflower oils, and soybean oils. The company was founded in 2014 and is based in Besiktas, Turkey.
